budgetNote: 编辑规划估算，人民币／人／天；按普通双人间两人分摊住宿，包含餐饮、当地交通与门票预留。不是实时价格；独自一人、儿童、节假日和具体房型需在预算表中调整。港澳台预算以人民币规划，不代表实时汇率。
budgetNoteEn: Editorial planning allowances in CNY per person per day cover accommodation, meals, local transport and admission. The base assumes two people sharing a double room. Return travel is separate. Solo rooms, child discounts, holidays and actual room choices need adjustment. Currency conversions are indicative and do not establish local payment currencies.

广东.scope: 每城至少8个是起点，不是上限。广东21市已各收录10个有来源的景点，继续补充；详细攻略与名录基础资料分别标示，现行票价、开放、评价及图片未全部核实。

en.scope: At least 8 attractions per city is a minimum, not a cap. Each of Guangdong’s 21 cities now has 10 sourced entries, with more to follow. Detailed guides and directory records are labeled separately; current prices, opening, reviews and photos are not all verified.

contentPolicy.countingRule: 每城至少8个是最低收录标准，不是数量上限，景点持续补充。仅统计有可追溯资料的独立景点；待调研线索不计入，同一复合景区不拆分凑数。数量达标不代表票价、开放、评价和图片全部完成核实。
